_purpose: Manual run inputs for the deployed child flow, REV | Ops | Failure Alert. Run it from the Power Automate portal and paste one set of five values.

_severityMapping._anythingElse: 3 (Error) - the mapping falls through to Error, it never fails

_everyCaseExpects: one new rev_errorlog row, rev_name in the form ERR-yyyyMMdd-nnnn
rev_occurredon set to the run time
a Teams message to the process owner
a 200 response carrying errorLogReference, logged and alerted
_personalDataRule: rev_recordreference is a reference only - never a name, an email address or narrative text. Every value below obeys that, and so must every calling flow.
